M O N T S E R R A T
No. 4 of 2016
AN ACT TO AMEND THE INSURANCE ACT (CAP.11.20).
BE IT ENACTED by The Queen’s Most Excellent Majesty, by and
with the advice and consent of the Legislative Assembly of
Montserrat and by the authority of the same as follows:
1 Short title
This Act may be cited as the Insurance (Amendment)
Act, 2016.
2 Section 46 amended
Section 46(1)(b)(i) of the Insurance Act (Cap.11.20) is
amended by deleting “$5000” and substituting
“$500,000”.
2
